report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is not supported by current telemetry. Traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and postgres spans returning 200/ok. Metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders 200 with zero 502s; v2.0.0 shows zero traffic. Deployment record only proves version 1.0.0 facts and cannot establish deployment-caused latency. No bounded cause is established; hand off.
